name: W Hotel Edinburgh
insider_take: This sleek W Hotel brings New York glamour to Edinburgh's historic Royal Mile, sitting boldly where medieval Scotland meets modern luxury.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a stunning 1930s former bank building, blending Art Deco architecture with W's signature contemporary design. You're literally steps from Edinburgh Castle and St. Giles' Cathedral, yet ensconced in ultra-modern luxury with panoramic city views from the top floors.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing south for unobstructed views of Edinburgh Castle – especially magical during the Edinburgh Festival Fireworks in August.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar offers one of Edinburgh's best castle views, while the location puts you at the heart of the Royal Mile's whisky shops and within a 2-minute walk of Deacon's Cafe – a local favorite hidden down a medieval close that tourists often miss.
pros: Prime location on Princes Street with stunning Edinburgh Castle views
Contemporary luxury design with signature W Hotels lifestyle amenities
Modern fitness center and spa facilities
Vibrant rooftop bar and innovative dining experiences
cons: Modern design may not appeal to traditional luxury preferences
